metadata.title: COSU Library Catalog Terminal SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Library Catalog Terminals as constrained endpoint execution environments for discovery and lookup of library resources.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to the discovery, lookup, and availability checking of library collections and public academic resources, with no general-purpose computing capability.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Library Catalog Terminals inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for library catalog discovery and lookup.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved library catalog, discovery, and resource availability applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Library Catalog Terminals do not require persistent user authentication; interactions are anonymous or transient.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Library Catalog Terminals are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Library Catalog Terminals are centrally enrolled, configured, monitored, and reset.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for management, integrity verification, and controlled access to catalog services.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables shell access, removable media, file downloads, local storage, and non-catalog applications.

props.name: session-isolation
props.remarks: Each interaction session is isolated and automatically cleared after inactivity or session end.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved library catalogs, discovery platforms, authentication brokers (where applicable), and management services.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Search history, credentials, and user-entered data must not be persisted locally.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Library Catalog Terminals may interact only with public or minimally sensitive bibliographic and availability data.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: A discovery-focused COSU endpoint does not imply trust as a workstation or eligibility for higher-classification data.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Library Catalog Terminals must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery to support user discovery and access.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Device health, catalog service availability, and tamper or misuse events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Library Catalog Terminals support automated reset, routine reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Library Catalog Terminals implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on privacy-preserving discovery, minimal attack surface, and high availability.

roles.title: Library Technology Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, configuration, monitoring, and availability of Library Catalog Terminals.

roles.title: Library Services Governance
roles.remarks: Approves catalog platforms, discovery integrations, and content scope.

control-implementation.remarks: Library Catalog Terminal implementations may use kiosk-mode operating systems or embedded platforms and are maintained as tightly controlled, versioned configuration baselines aligned with this SSPP.
